title: Summa MST Liability Aggregator
description: Given up to 16 (id, balance) leaf entries, deterministically builds a SHA-256 Merkle-sum-tree and emits the root commitment {hash, sum} plus every leaf's full inclusion proof. Applies Maxwell's (eprint 2022/043) mandatory range-check mitigation on the input side before building the tree. Pattern-borrowed from Summa (PSE)'s proof-of-reserves node layout, no code vendored. The generator counterpart to the MST inclusion checker (art-620) -- its proofs are consumable directly as that tool's input. Verify-only: commits to whatever balances it is given, never asserts they reflect real reserves.

leaves.description: 1-16 leaf entries. More than 16 is a declared-invalid-input error, never a larger tree.

id.description: Opaque, already-hashed account identifier. Never a raw username, account number, or email -- zero-PII.

balance.description: Non-negative decimal string, parsed as BigInt. Never a JSON number (precision loss above 2^53).

max_balance.description: Optional declared MAX_BALANCE domain bound as a decimal string. Any leaf balance above it is rejected. Defaults to 1000000000000000 (10^15 base units) if omitted.

mcp_tool_definition.name: aggregate_summa_mst_liabilities
mcp_tool_definition.description: Builds a SHA-256 Merkle-sum-tree over up to 16 (id, balance) leaves and emits the root commitment plus every leaf's inclusion proof, after rejecting negative or over-bound balances on the input side. Verify-only.

leaves.description: Array of {id, balance} (balance as a decimal string), 1-16 entries.
